_note: Broths and spice levels for the checkout flow (doc 18.1). Broth names were originally the four on bigwayhotpot.com/menu, developer-supplied; cut to three (one veg, two nonveg) 2026-08-25 for the broth screen's new full-height card redesign -- Miso Broth dropped, developer's own choice, kept as the veg option was Mushroom Vegan Broth over Miso. `diet` is INFERRED FROM THE NAME and is not confirmed with the restaurant -- mala is traditionally a beef-tallow base and bone broth is bone, so both are marked nonveg; confirm before this is ever shown to a real diner. `note` and `meta` follow the same rules as pricing.Item.description: ASCII only (UiLayer loads Latin1Supplement + CurrencySymbols, so an em-dash silently does not render), and never an instruction -- the kitchen cooks, the diner chooses.

broths.note: Numbing and fiery, built on Sichuan pepper and chilli. The boldest broth here.
broths.note_zh: 麻辣鲜香,以四川花椒和辣椒为底,是全场最浓烈的汤底。

broths.note: Deep and savoury with no meat at all. Earthy rather than rich.
broths.note_zh: 浓郁鲜美,全素无肉,菌香清雅而不厚重。

broths.note: Milky and slow simmered. Rich on the tongue but completely mild.
broths.note_zh: 汤色乳白,慢火熬制,口感浓郁却十分温和。

spice_levels.note: Plain broth, no chilli at all. A real choice here, not a fallback.
spice_levels.note_zh: 清汤原味,不含辣椒,是真正的选项而非退而求其次。

spice_levels.note: A gentle warmth. You taste the broth first and the chilli after.
spice_levels.note_zh: 微微辛辣,先尝到汤底的鲜美,辣味随后而来。

spice_levels.note: Properly spicy and still comfortable. The most ordered level.
spice_levels.note_zh: 辣度适中,爽快不过火,是点单最多的选择。

spice_levels.note: Serious heat. Worth choosing only if you already know you like it.
spice_levels.note_zh: 辣度强烈,建议确定自己能接受辣味后再选择。
